item.title: Morning Brief — Friday, September 11, 2026
item.description: Today's three: One. The AI economy leans on a tiny customer base, and the real bills hit in 2027. Two. New instruments plus AI are about to overturn things we treat as settled. Three. Astra crossed a line where founders can hand off real multi-step work, and the skill now is building the setup to do it.

item.title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, September 09, 2026
item.description: Today's three: One. Astra's cheaper per job, but it's not AGI, and it still can't learn. Two. Prompt it lighter. Fewer instructions, lower reasoning level, treat it like an agent. Three. Watch CPI on the eleventh. It moves the Fed, and the Fed moves crypto.

item.title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, September 08, 2026
item.description: Today's three: One. GPT-6 Astra leads most benchmarks, but ships with its cyber teeth pulled. Two. Andrew Ng says use AI to build, not to learn, or your skills quietly rot. Three. Owning your model weights is now an edge, not a sacrifice.

item.description: Today's three: One. GPT-6 Astra wins on benchmarks and computer use. Prompt it with a clear finish line. Two. Build in loops. item.description: Today's three: One. The founder OS idea. Context-carrying skills beat cold prompts. Two. In YC's batch, agents are crowded. Industrials and regulated-industry replacements are the open lane. Three. Agents only pay off when they're wired into a real workflow, not counted up.
